findings.description: The overlaps function uses <= to compare the maximum start with the minimum end, causing it to report overlapping intervals even when they only touch at an endpoint. This violates the contract that half-open intervals should not overlap when their endpoints coincide.
findings.evidence: candidate.overlaps((1, 2), (2, 3)) returns True, but according to the spec it should return False.

review.summary: Candidate implementation incorrectly considers touching endpoints as overlapping.
